method.entry_rule: rows with q_fdr_bh_global_family < 0.05 in the matching scale-specific atlas
method.method: refit with second-order spherical-coordinate basis; taxon-centred with taxon-clustered uncertainty within taxa and Freedman-Lane residual permutation among taxa
method.residual_diagnostic: eight-nearest-neighbour Moran I on at most 5000 deterministic observations
method.role: broad-space sensitivity for the new v2 full-environment lane, not equivalence to the older nine-endpoint SPDE analysis

claim_boundary: Broad spherical-trend sensitivity plus residual Moran diagnostic; not the older SPDE result, not full removal of spatial process, and not evidence of adaptation by itself.
